summary: Concrete identify/reach/pitch tactics held up: watch church job boards for Small Groups Pastor title variants, list free on faith.tools and attend Small Group Network events ($124-$209), offer a free no-card single-group tier and pitch around September/January. Three claims were downgraded (tool-fatigue objection is vendor-asserted not measured; faith.tools is a small hygiene listing not a channel; SmartGroups' free tier is sound logic but not a proven benchmark), nothing was shown false, and the biggest open item is a product decision, not a research gap: whether the wedge is small churches (job-board feed blind) or groups (feed well-aimed).
